name: luxury-yacht-vacation
image_purpose: Luxury travel and lifestyle social content

prompt.project_info: Create a premium but natural-looking luxury yacht vacation lifestyle image for social media.
prompt.main_subject: One generic approved adult woman relaxing barefoot on the bow sofa of a modern grey-silver sport yacht. She wears a black sleeveless tank top and dark fitted trousers, with a calm, comfortable expression and natural posture.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical 3:4 high-angle framing. Keep the woman prominent in the lower center, with the U-shaped yacht sofa, teak deck, open water, foamy wake, and distant industrial coastline visible around her. Include understated champagne and fruit on the side table without readable branding.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft overcast daylight, cool blue-grey sea, hazy horizon, gentle natural contrast, quiet premium travel atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic mobile lifestyle photography, vertical 3:4, natural skin texture, realistic anatomy and hands, balanced highlights, no artificial text or watermarks.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Photorealistic vertical 3:4 high-angle luxury yacht vacation lifestyle photo, one generic approved adult woman relaxing barefoot on a light grey U-shaped sofa at the bow of a modern silver-grey sport yacht, black sleeveless tank top, dark fitted trousers, teak deck, calm natural pose, champagne and fruit on a side table, choppy blue-grey sea with a frothy wake, hazy overcast sky and distant industrial coastline, soft cool daylight, premium candid social-media aesthetic, realistic anatomy, natural skin texture, no branding, no watermark.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexualized pose, fetish styling, nudity, minors, celebrity likeness, public-figure likeness, distorted anatomy, extra fingers, malformed hands, duplicate subject, unreadable text, logos, watermark

assets.name: luxury-yacht-vacation reference
assets.usage: Match the yacht setting, relaxed seated pose, vertical framing, wardrobe, and cool coastal palette while keeping the adult subject generic and replaceable.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach the required reference image. Preserve the yacht architecture, sofa placement, composition, lighting mood, outfit category, and overall travel-lifestyle consistency. The person, outfit details, yacht, accessories, and environment must remain replaceable. Remove any incidental logos or readable branding.
